title: AmbiHTMLBench: A Benchmark for HTML-based Visually Rich Document parsing
abstract: arXiv:2611.06449v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Traditional document parsing systems use Markdown as their output representation, which is effective for linear text but does not fully preserve fine-grained spatial structure, table geometry, visual hierarchy, or rendering semantics. We show that HTML is advantageous for heterogeneous and layout-sensitive documents whose representations must remain editable, inspectable, and reusable, and introduce AmbiHTMLBench to systematically study this setting. In this benchmark, given a real-world document, a model must recover executable HTML that preserves its content, organization, and visual appearance. translated_title: AmbiHTMLBench：基于HTML的视觉丰富文档解析基准
translated_abstract: 传统文档解析系统使用Markdown作为输出表示形式，这对线性文本很有效，但无法完整保留细粒度的空间结构、表格几何形状、视觉层次或渲染语义。我们证明HTML对于异构且布局敏感的文档更具优势，这类文档的表示形式需要保持可编辑、可检查和可复用，并引入AmbiHTMLBench来系统性地研究这一场景。在该基准中，给定一个真实世界的文档，模型必须恢复出能够保留其内容、组织和视觉外观的可执行HTML。该基准包含1,115个带有结构化标注的多样化页面，并通过两种不同方式评估预测结果：客观协议将真实值与预测的渲染块进行对齐，衡量表格保真度、页面级文本错误和二维布局一致性；补充的参考锚定协议则衡量感知……
tldr: 提出了AmbiHTMLBench基准，评估模型将真实世界文档恢复为保留内容、组织结构与视觉外观的可执行HTML的能力，以解决传统Markdown输出无法保留细粒度空间结构和渲染语义的问题。
en_tdlr: Introduces AmbiHTMLBench, a benchmark of 1,115 diverse annotated pages for evaluating HTML-based visually rich document parsing, where models must recover executable HTML preserving content, organization, and visual appearance, addressing Markdown's failure to capture fine-grained spatial structure and rendering semantics.
